name: harness-start
description: Harness Start plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: evidence-based-research
plugins.description: Enforces captured, anchored, fresh, machine-verifiable evidence for explicit research tasks.

plugins.name: execution-discipline
plugins.description: Detects repeated edits, blind command retries, and excessive remote polling before agents waste a session.

plugins.name: source-integrity
plugins.description: Protects source filenames, replacement characters, and strict UTF-8 encoding.

plugins.name: git-delivery
plugins.description: Guards local Git commands, atomic commits, repository state, and unresolved merge markers.

plugins.name: engineering-quality
plugins.description: Enforces language-neutral line budgets and Markdown structure.

plugins.name: android-engineering
plugins.description: Android, Gradle, AGP, Compose, testing, and R8 engineering.

plugins.name: go-engineering
plugins.description: Go module, service, CLI, concurrency, and test engineering.

plugins.name: ios-engineering
plugins.description: Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, concurrency, testing, and dependency engineering.

plugins.name: java-engineering
plugins.description: Java, Spring Boot, Maven, Gradle, JUnit, and Jakarta engineering.

plugins.name: kubernetes-operations
plugins.description: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, RBAC, storage, and safe operations.

plugins.name: nix-engineering
plugins.description: Nix language, flakes, NixOS, Home Manager, and reproducible environments.

plugins.name: php-engineering
plugins.description: Multi-framework PHP and Composer engineering.

plugins.name: python-engineering
plugins.description: Python packaging, typing, testing, async, service, and CLI engineering.

plugins.name: react-native-engineering
plugins.description: Bare React Native, Metro, navigation, upgrade, Codegen, and native boundary engineering.

plugins.name: rust-engineering
plugins.description: Rust ownership, errors, async, unsafe, API, test, and Cargo engineering.

plugins.name: web-frontend-engineering
plugins.description: React, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, testing, and frontend performance engineering.

plugins.name: test-driven-development
plugins.description: Requires an observed failing test before implementation and a relevant passing test before completion.

plugins.name: command-safety
plugins.description: Command safety guards: deny broad recursive deletion, unbacked sed in-place edits, and cat heredoc writes outside temporary directories.

plugins.name: language-output
plugins.description: Keeps agent prose aligned with a stable, configurable session language across Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: intent-discovery
plugins.description: Front-loads first-turn context and bounded adversarial review, and can be routed again for a materially new task without an interview gate.

plugins.name: interface-craft
plugins.description: Supplies visual direction, project design memory, motion, rendered critique, and mechanical interface checks.

plugins.name: engineering-practice
plugins.description: Orchestrates first-party implementation, read-only review, and completion-verification methods.

plugins.name: professional-writing
plugins.description: Orchestrates language-aware writing Skills and reports deterministic AI-style signals after observed Markdown writes.

plugins.name: reasoning-methods
plugins.description: Provides adaptive first-principles and verification-oriented reasoning methods without a file-backed workflow.

plugins.name: agent-activity-audit
plugins.description: Records protected per-session file and command activity.

plugins.name: software-debugging
plugins.description: Activates evidence-first, multi-bug debugging only through an explicit on-disk Debug Work Order.

plugins.name: presentation-production
plugins.description: Guards PptxGenJS slide modules, hash-bound SVG diagram assets, source-bound previews, generated writers, and release evidence.

plugins.name: diagram-production
plugins.description: Produces deterministic diagrams from semantic JSON or bounded Mermaid/draw.io imports, with SVG/PNG/HTML/draw.io outputs and release evidence.

plugins.name: poster-production
plugins.description: Guards ordered Satori layers, paired proofs, generated writers, and poster release evidence.

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Guards Remotion visual/audio frame projections, media proofs, and final video evidence.

plugins.name: brand-logo-production
plugins.description: Guards logo concepts, native-vector masters, construction sheets, variants, and release evidence.

plugins.name: print-publication-production
plugins.description: Guards static publication units, Paged Media sources, print PDFs, and preflight evidence.

plugins.name: music-production
plugins.description: Guards brief-to-release Tone.js music projects with current-source advisers, independent review, one-shot writers, and digest-bound WAV evidence.

plugins.name: work-reporting
plugins.description: Creates guided daily, weekly, and range work reports from local transcripts, then protects confirmed bodies with SHA-256 seals and append-only additions.

plugins.name: spec-driven-development
plugins.description: Guides lightweight SDD and validates recognized spec, plan, and tasks writes with digest freshness.

plugins.name: ci-gated-delivery
plugins.description: Guides code and configuration changes through branch, review, remote CI, merge, post-merge verification, and cleanup.

plugins.name: repository-history-migration
plugins.description: Plans and executes sealed, source-read-only Git history extraction into a new repository.

plugins.name: training-program-design
plugins.description: Designs and guards evidence-bound training packages for audiences with varied starting levels.
